source: Words that are the same in both languages, such as "Plugins" in German, are still reported. That is why the check reports at {0}, which {1} does not turn into an error. {2} removes such keys, from every check.
text: Wörter, die in beiden Sprachen gleich sind, etwa „Plugins“ im Deutschen, werden dennoch gemeldet. Deshalb meldet die Prüfung bei {0}, was {1} nicht in einen Fehler umwandelt. {2} entfernt solche Schlüssel aus jeder Prüfung.
